kiimento kiimento
Lead caliente
123
  • 1. “The early gifts are almost gone”
    Qué: The headline sells urgency, not the camera. Por qué: Any toy brand can say this in November. It gives a parent no reason to choose kiimento. Cómo: Lead with the idea only you own, a first camera that is really theirs, and let the offer sit underneath.
  • 2. “keep forever”
    Qué: Your strongest idea lives on a sticker. Por qué: Keeping their childhood photos is the reason to pay more than a toy camera, and it reads as decoration. Cómo: Promote it to the first line people read.
  • 3. “As seen in”
    Qué: Forbes and National Geographic sit below the fold. Por qué: Press is proof you lead the category, but here it reads as a logo strip after a sale banner. Cómo: Put one press line next to the promise, near the headline.
Geist Brewing Co. drinkgeist
Lead caliente
123
  • 1. “International award-winning Indian”
    Qué: The bio opens with awards, not with what Geist is. Por qué: Awards are proof. The first line should be the reason to pick Geist over every other craft brewery in Bengaluru. Cómo: Lead with one line only Geist can say and keep the awards as the proof under it.
  • 2. “Kolkata”
    Qué: The highlights read as a list of cities. Por qué: A distribution map tells people where to buy, not why to care. It is the first row of the brand world they see. Cómo: Turn the highlights into the Geist world: the beers, the taprooms, the people behind them.
  • 3. “POP FICTION”
    Qué: The beer artwork is the most distinctive thing on the profile. Por qué: That illustration style is an identity no other brewery can copy, and the grid mixes it with event photos. Cómo: Make the can art the system for the grid so every post looks like Geist.
